answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked before it can submit work, then slash that bond when independent reviewers confirm a duplicate or fabricated identity. A dawn-time registration window can make newcomers wait for the next batch, while reviewers compare behavior across tasks rather than trusting an ivory profile or a raven-like burst of accounts. Sybils remain possible, but each added identity ties up real capital and risks losing it, so multiplying accounts to capture rewards becomes costly rather than free.
